name: Site-First SEO
author: POTAR

sections.description:
Site-First SEO is the modern WordPress SEO plugin designed for both traditional SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Instead of relying on third-party APIs, Site-First SEO helps you optimize your site directly, so you perform better in Google search results and emerging AI-driven engines like ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and Gemini.

Whether you’re running a personal blog, a business site, or managing multiple client websites, Site-First SEO helps you analyze, optimize, and improve:

🔎 Core Features

  • Content Quality Audit: Check readability, keyword density, and on-page SEO signals.
  • Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Tools: Ensure your site is “AI-ready” with answerability checks, structured data validation, and authority scoring for better visibility in generative search.
  • Internal Links Analysis: Find orphan pages, improve site architecture, and boost crawl depth.
  • Image & Link Audit: Catch missing alt tags, broken links, and critical SEO errors.
  • Redirect Manager & 404 Log: Easily create redirects, monitor 404s, and recover lost SEO value.
  • Visits Tracker: Lightweight, privacy-friendly analytics that include AI crawler detection (e.g., GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot).
  • XML Sitemap Generator: Automatic, clean sitemaps that search engines understand.

🚀 Why Choose Site-First SEO?

  • Built for GEO: Stay ahead with Generative Engine Optimization support.
  • API-free: No Google API keys needed, works right away.
  • Lightweight & fast: Minimal overhead, optimized database queries.
  • Clean interface: Essential SEO tools, no constant upsells.
  • Agency-friendly: Clear reports, content scoring, and client-ready insights.

Unlike bulky SEO plugins such as Yoast, Rank Math, or All in One SEO, Site-First SEO focuses on practical on-site optimization and the future of AI-driven search visibility.

🌍 Who Is It For?

  • WordPress users who want SEO essentials without bloat
  • Agencies and freelancers who need client-friendly SEO + GEO reports
  • Bloggers and businesses preparing for AI-driven search engines
  • Professionals seeking a lightweight alternative to larger SEO plugins
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/site-first-seo, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Access Site-First SEO from your WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of optimizing your content so that AI-driven search engines like ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and Gemini can understand, cite, and surface your site in their answers. Site-First SEO includes GEO tools such as answerability checks, structured data validation, and AI crawler tracking.

How does Site-First SEO help with GEO?

Site-First SEO checks if your pages are AI-ready: do they have concise answer blocks, schema markup, outbound authority citations, and strong internal linking? The plugin assigns a GEO Score to help you identify content most likely to appear in AI summaries.

Does Site-First SEO replace Yoast, Rank Math, or All in One SEO?

Yes, in most cases. Site-First SEO includes the most important features like content audits, internal links analysis, redirects, sitemaps, and GEO reporting without the heavy overhead or aggressive upsells.

Do I need API keys or Google Search Console connected?

No. Site-First SEO was built to work without external APIs. All features run directly inside WordPress.

Will Site-First SEO slow down my site?

No. Site-First SEO is designed for lightweight performance with efficient scans and optimized database queries.

Is there a PRO version?

Yes. Site-First SEO PRO adds advanced tools like Redirect Intelligence, BOT Block, GEO content scoring, extended AI-readiness reporting, and professional-grade client reports.

Can I track AI bot traffic (like GPTBot or PerplexityBot)?

Yes. The Visits Tracker automatically detects common AI crawlers so you can see if your site is being indexed by generative engines.
